blocks.text: Carpet Removal Service The GTA Actually Relies On

c: Most people who’ve tried removing carpet themselves will tell you the same thing: the carpet isn’t even the hard part. It’s the staples hammered into every square foot of subfloor, the tack strips nailed around the perimeter, and the underlay backing that tears instead of lifting cleanly. A single room can take hours. A whole floor can wreck a weekend. For GTA homeowners and landlords managing turnovers, renovation timelines, or estate clearouts, a professional
isn’t a luxury — it’s the smarter call.

Live Junk Free handles the complete job across the Greater Toronto Area — carpet, underlay, tack strips, and all associated debris — hauled away in a single visit. We offer same-day and next-day availability in most GTA areas, pricing confirmed upfront before we lift a single corner, and disposal handled responsibly through certified recycling channels wherever possible. Give us a call and we’ll handle the rest.

blocks.text: Carpet Removal Service — Questions GTA Homeowners Ask Most

items.q: What types of carpets do you remove?
a: We remove all types, including plush, berber, shag, commercial, and stained or damaged carpets.

items.q: Do you remove carpet padding and underlay as well?
a: Yes, we remove both the carpet and its padding/underlay unless you request otherwise.

items.q: Is your carpet removal service available for both small and large spaces?
a: Yes, we handle small rooms, whole homes, and large commercial areas.

items.q: How long does carpet removal usually take?
a: A standard room takes about 30–60 minutes, while larger spaces may take a few hours.

items.q: Can you handle carpets that are glued or stapled down?
a: Yes, we remove carpets secured with glue, staples, tack strips, or other methods.
